integrity: Full all-parameter proof supplied; finite standard-library numerical checks supplement the proof and do not establish novelty or infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns symmetric continuous-time Laplacian spectral-gap design with identical prices in each wheel edge orbit and freely nonnegative individual conductances; it does not classify all nonsymmetric equality-price optimizers. Specialized prior coverage remains possible.
title: Sharp rim-edge deletion and unrestricted rigidity in priced wheel diffusion
